generalInfo.generalRule: The following items will not be permitted in the stadium: * Weapons: No weapons are allowed in the stadium. Possession of a firearm or weapon that potentially disrupts the ability to maintain a safe and enjoyable environment is strictly forbidden. Possession of such a weapon will result in immediate confiscation ejection, and possible arrest. * Alcoholic beverages * Animals (except assistive animals for people with disabilities) * Banners * Cans, bottles, or other beverages containers including bottled water * Confetti or glitter * Ice chests * Fireworks, or missile-like objects * Flash photography * Illegal substances * Laser pointers * Noisemaking device: ie bells, bullhorns, whistles, etc. * Smoking * Sticks, bats, or clubs * Strollers * Umbrellas * Video or movie cameras, tripods, or audio recording equipment * Any other item deemed dangerous and/or inappropriate

events.name: The Night Owls
events.info: The Night Owls are a 10-piece band playing hot jazz and dance music from the 1920s and early 1930s. Come join us at Treelawn where you can hear us improving our repertoire while you enjoy some refreshments from the bar, and maybe you will be inspired to get up and dance!The band is composed of: George Cyphers, reeds; George Foley, piano; Bill Fuller, drums; Kevin Glordano, reeds; Peter Hoekje, trumpet; Roland Kausen, banjo; Drew Krieger, tuba ; Mark Perry, Trombone; Richard Rayer, Reeds; Reinhold Toerek, trumpet.

events.name: DownRiver Collective
events.info: Join us October 18th at the Treelawn for a special evening with DownRiver Collective, the 2024 IBMA Momentum Band of the Year. The Nashville-based group has quickly become one of the most talked-about emerging acts in bluegrass music, earning recognition for their fresh sound and standout musicianship.Blending bluegrass roots with Americana, folk, and country influences, DownRiver Collective delivers rich harmonies, heartfelt songwriting, and high-energy performances that appeal to both traditional and modern music fans alike.
